technical.summary: Strong trend structure with ADX confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 92+, Stoch 95+) combined with stochastic bearish cross and narrow Bollinger Band bandwidth signal elevated pullback risk despite bullish price structure.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 55 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional conviction and news data limits conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed retail positioning.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (348.8), flat yield curve with recession signals, CPI event in 2 days, and macro_score of -5 create severely adverse conditions; earnings in 55 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX-confirmed strong trend with price above all moving averages and new 20-day highs, combined with extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) creating contrarian buy opportunity at support zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 92+, Stoch 95+ with bearish cross), unfavorable macro environment (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, CPI event in 2 days), zero fundamental conviction, and narrow Bollinger Band bandwidth signal imminent pullback risk that outweighs trend strength.

decision.entry_rationale: ADX-confirmed uptrend with price above all moving averages offers structural bullish setup; extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) creates contrarian opportunity. However, extreme overbought conditions (RSI 92+, Stoch 95+ with bearish cross) and unfavorable macro environment (CPI event in 2 days, flat yield curve) present unacceptable risk/reward at current price near resistance.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme overbought technicals combined with VIX crisis regime and imminent CPI event create high probability of sharp pullback that could trigger stop-loss before trend continuation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk despite bullish structure
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MPC position with 28 other Energy holdings (7.3% sector concentration); adding to existing position during overbought conditions and high portfolio Energy exposure violates concentration discipline.
